result.topic_en: Scratch notes on Abelian functions: period moduli $a$ of a surface cut into a simply connected region, the bilinear relations between periods, a count of the genus from branch points, and the number of transcendental relations among the moduli $a_{\iota,\iota'}$, with sketches of cut rectangles and circles.

methods.what: Relation between genus/degree, number of periods and branch points (Riemann–Hurwitz type count)
Boundary integral of $u\,du'$ around cut surface with period terms
Bilinear combination of periods (Riemann bilinear relation)
Normalized period matrix with $\pi i$ diagonal and moduli $a_{\iota,\iota'}$
Exponent quadratic form of theta series
Count of independent relations among the $a_{\iota,\iota'}$ (number of parameters minus moduli)
